title: plugin-auth registers sys_organization_detail unconditionally, so a host with its own default organization record page cannot compose without it — at v18 the cloud control plane's boot is refused (DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). This is the fork that ruling A on #23015 (`6134056653`) asks the cloud seat to report. Source: the cloud re-pin round report objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 `6145524807`, measured at framework `01a3421f42`. **It blocks cloud's v18 upgrade (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so it is filed `priority:p1`.**

## What happens

At `01a3421f42` (which carries `5f37d36ce3`, PR #23206, ruling A on #23015), a deployment may hold one `isDefault: true` record page per object. Cloud's control plane registers two for `sys_organization`:
- **`cloud_organization_detail`** (`com.objectstack.service-tenant`): cloud's workspace page, a maintainer-ruled product surface (objectstack-ai/cloud#2773, #2774);
- **`sys_organization_detail`:** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:674` registers it unconditionally.

The kernel refuses the boot with `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`. The cloud console cannot start, and 15 `apps/cloud` and 2 `service-cloud` test files are blocked (0 failed + 419 blocked).

## Why the ruling's two routes do not reach it today

Ruling A keeps one page "by overlay-by-name or by composition".
- **Overlay-by-name, measured:** a page of the same name, `sys_organization_detail`, shipped by service-tenant still conflicts at registration. Per #23206, an environment save of a page is refused `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.
- **Composition:** plugin-auth has no option to leave its organization page out, so a host cannot compose the plane without it.

**Demoted for measurement only** (cloud's page `isDefault: false`, never committed), everything passes: `apps/cloud` 740/740, `service-cloud` 4359/4359, the console boot, and `verify-console-pin`. Demotion is not taken as the fix, because it leaves the console on registration order, the state ruling A rejects ("no silent D").

## What cloud needs

The composition route ruling A names: a plugin-auth option (or an equivalent host-composition switch) to leave out its `sys_organization` default record page, so that a host shipping its own page is the single default by construction.
- Cloud then composes without plugin-auth's page and retires its order-pinning test (objectstack-ai/cloud#2773).
- ⛔ No precedence ladder and no registration-order rule (ruling A).
- The lane may find a better shape within ruling A. This card asks only that a host can ship the one default.

## Order

objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 lands only after this fix and one more pin bump.
